Gholdengo and Kingambit provide a potent Steel duo with Good as Gold blocking status moves, Dragonite and Garchomp give powerful physical attackers with priority and speed control, Primarina offers a special Water/Fairy breaker, and Rotom-Wash serves as a bulky pivot with Volt Switch. The team covers most threats with good type synergy and flexible 3-pick options.</thought>

<thought>Gholdengo runs a Choice Scarf set to outspeed and revenge-kill with Make It Rain and Shadow Ball, while Kingambit is the late-game cleaner with Swords Dance, Sucker Punch, and Supreme Overlord boosted by Black Glasses. Dragonite uses Multiscale with Lum Berry to safely Dragon Dance and sweep with Extreme Speed priority, and Garchomp provides a fast physical attacker with Yache Berry to survive Ice moves. Primarina acts as a bulky special breaker with Mystic Water-boosted Sparkling Aria and coverage, while Rotom-Wash is the defensive pivot with Leftovers, Will-O-Wisp, and Volt Switch to maintain momentum.</thought>
